intelligence.human_view: Imagine a shop that lets you live in the house for nine days before you pay a cent — and if you walk away, the friend who showed you around stays your friend. That is the whole deal: nine days up front, no refunds because there is nothing to refund, and Naya stays with you either way — only the connection to the net, Naya Power, is what the trial decides. Once you are in, the teaching is four deep videos, one a day, that show you exactly what to do — and a fifth that tells you what you actually joined, before any of the steps. Sharing is taught three ways so everyone finds the one that fits them: one tap, one picture, or your own domain. And every page you meet is built the same way the agreement is built: one frame at a time, each frame answering what it is, why it matters, and what's in it for you — so a child gets it and a grandma gets it.
intelligence.simple_view: Nine days to try it, and you keep Naya even if you leave! Naya Power is the plug you keep or lose, like plugging your computer into the internet! Share it three ways: tap a button, share a picture, or get your own domain! Four videos teach you the whole plan, one deep dive each day, and a fifth video tells you what NayaNET really is! Don't just copy what Shawn says — think, and say it the best way you can! Your About page is like a little book, one frame at a time, and every frame says what it is, why it matters, and what's in it for you!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you get nine whole days to try it before you pay anything, dear, and if it's not for you, you just don't keep her, no problem at all! And you never lose Naya herself, love — only the plug-in, like unplugging from the internet, that's all! The teaching comes in four lovely videos, dear, one each day, deep and complete, and a fifth one that tells you what it all really is! And your About page, love — it's like a little book, one frame at a time, each frame telling you what it is, why it matters, and what's in it for you, so plain a child understands it and so plain you understand it too, dear!
intelligence.naya_view: Tell the thesis first — before features, plan, and price: intelligence is doing the most intelligent thing; the highest honor is to serve; our job is 10-star service; the mother brain everybody plugs into; everybody collectively more intelligent by plugging in; a new portal to the internet; we call her Naya. State the trial in one breath everywhere the offer is made: nine days up front, try before you buy, if you don't like it you don't keep her, no problem — and both halves of the keep: you keep Naya; Naya Power is your AI connected to NayaNet, like plugging your computer into the internet. Teach the three sharing ways in order, simplest first — button, image, domain — with his line as the example message. Build the series as four complete deep dives, one per day, plus Video 5, the thesis spoken aloud in the narrator format, never folded in as a fifth day. Before answering, ask what he is ultimately trying to say and return the ultimate version — his operative words verbatim where they decide, improved everywhere else. Build every About page frame by frame — frame 1 picture plus nutshell, whole profile one intelligent block — and repeat the one pattern in every frame and every Skills slide: what it is, why it matters, how it connects, what's in it for you. One page: About IS the profile.
